nodes.description: Public ERC20 token name string set only in the constructor.
Public ERC20 token symbol string set only in the constructor.
Public decimals value set only in the constructor.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor and never mutated afterwards.
Mapping address to token balance; minted in constructor and mutated by _transfer.
Nested mapping owner to spender to approved amount; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor that initialises name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
External transfer function: checks balanceOf[msg.sender] and delegates the state update to _transfer.
Internal helper that zero-address checks and moves balances between _from and _to, emitting Transfer.
External approval function that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
External delegated transfer that checks allowance, decrements the allowance and calls _transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as minter, balance owner, allowance owner and _from source.
Subtraction balanceOf[_from] - _value inside _transfer; potential underflow if checks are bypassed.
Addition balanceOf[_to] + _value inside _transfer; potential overflow of recipient balance.
Subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] - _value inside transferFrom; potential underflow of allowance.
Constructor parameter _name carrying the token name.
Constructor parameter _symbol carrying the token symbol.
Constructor parameter _decimals carrying the token decimals.
Constructor parameter _totalSupply used as the minted amount.
Parameter _to of transfer, the receiver of tokens.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount of tokens to send.
Parameter _from of _transfer, the address funds are taken from.
Parameter _to of _transfer, the receiver of tokens.
Parameter _value of _transfer, the amount moved between balances.
Parameter _spender of approve, the address granted an allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the approved spending limit.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the owner whose allowance is spent.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the receiver of tokens.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount of tokens to move.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the _name parameter into the name state variable.
Constructor writes the _symbol parameter into the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the _decimals parameter into the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the _totalSupply parameter into totalSupply.
Constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor uses msg.sender as the address that receives the initial minted supply.
Constructor parameter _name is read by the constructor.
Constructor parameter _symbol is read by the constructor.
Constructor parameter _decimals is read by the constructor.
Constructor parameter _totalSupply is read by the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the index when minting and when reading balances, giving the caller control over which balance is touched.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to enforce the require check.
transfer uses the untrusted msg.sender as the source of the funds.
transfer delegates the state update to the internal _transfer function.
transfer parameter _to is read by the transfer function.
transfer parameter _value is read by the transfer function.
transfer forwards its _to argument into _transfer.
transfer forwards its _value argument into _transfer.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both the sender and receiver.
_transfer parameter _from is read by _transfer.
_transfer parameter _to is read by _transfer.
_transfer parameter _value is read by _transfer.
_transfer executes the debiting subtraction balanceOf[_from] - _value.
The _from parameter indexes the mapping used in the subtraction.
The _value parameter is the subtrahend of the balance debit.
Result of the checked subtraction is written back into balanceOf[_from]; an unchecked variant would allow balance underflow.
The _to parameter indexes the mapping used in the addition.
The _value parameter is the addend of the balance credit.
_transfer executes the crediting addition balanceOf[_to] + _value.
Result of the addition is written back into balanceOf[_to]; an unchecked variant would allow balance overflow.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner, granting spend rights controlled by the caller.
approve parameter _spender is read by approve.
approve parameter _value is read by approve.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] to enforce the balance check.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom parameter _from is read by transferFrom.
transferFrom parameter _to is read by transferFrom.
transferFrom parameter _value is read by transferFrom.
transferFrom executes the allowance decrement subtraction.
The allowance mapping value is the minuend of the decrement.
msg.sender selects the spender slot of the allowance used in the subtraction.
The _value parameter is the subtrahend of the allowance decrement.
Result of the allowance subtraction is stored back into allowance[_from][msg.sender]; an unchecked variant would allow allowance underflow.
